aboutGame.title: What is Pull Big Things?
paragraphs: Pull Big Things is a Roblox game by Heavy Hit Games built around a simple goal: see how big an object you can pull. Train and upgrade your arms as you work toward heavier pulls.
Pulling heavier objects earns cash, and pets can help you along the way. Our guide introduces these core activities, while the codes page covers the current code status and future updates.

items.question: What is Pull Big Things?
items.answer: Pull Big Things is a Roblox game by Heavy Hit Games. Train, upgrade your arms, pull heavier objects to earn cash, and collect pets.

items.question: What should I do first in Pull Big Things?
items.answer: Start with training, explore arm upgrades, and try pulling objects you can manage. The beginner guide explains the core loop.

items.question: How do you earn cash in Pull Big Things?
items.answer: The official game description says you earn cash by pulling heavier objects.

items.question: Do pets help in Pull Big Things?
items.answer: Yes. The official description says you can collect pets to help you along the way.

items.answer: Visit the codes page for its current status and links to the official game details.
